title: Interest of Ultrasound in the Diagnosis of Severity of Lateral Ankle Sprain
official: Interest of Ultrasound in the Diagnosis of Severity of Lateral Ankle Sprain
summary: Ankle sprain is a frequent and widely trivialized trauma. Misdiagnosed or poorly treated, it can recur and thus develop into chronic ankle instability. It can be associated with complications which, if not detected early, can lead to long-term sequelae.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* First ankle sprain with sport or work disability

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient with fractures, dislocation or hyperlaxity
* Previous ankle sprain
sponsor: Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Saint Etienne
